title: Cap Chaos level — format v2
description: One level, fully data-driven (GDD §6). Written for designers and their own tools: every colour is a NUMBER (see $defs.colorId), every flag is a named field. Structural checks live here; semantic checks (floating bottles, hidden-on-ground, colour balance, solvability, link targets) are LevelValidator V2–V7. Format v1 files (letter codes) still load: level.schema.v1.json.

id.description: Must equal the file name without extension.

colors.description: Palette subset used by this level. Hex values live in DesignTokens, never here.

layers.description: layers[0] is the GROUND. Each layer is `rows` rows of `cols` cells; row 0 is the BACK row, the last row is the FRONT row (nearest the player).

hidden.description: Hidden bottles (R4): shown as rainbow until they reach the ground. Each names a non-empty cell. V3: never on layer 0.

lanes.description: Conveyor queues left→right. Element [0] of each lane is the tappable front tray.

links.description: Linked tray pairs (R19): they fly to the slots together (2 free slots needed); belts carrying a pair across two lanes only move together. V7: two neighbours in one lane, or the same position of two neighbouring lanes; a tray is in at most one link and is never locked.

solution.description: One winning tap sequence (lane indices). Written by Tools/LevelTool; V6 replays it as the solvability proof.

colorId.description: Game.Domain.CapColor: 1 Red (pink-red) · 2 Orange · 3 Blue · 4 Green · 5 Purple · 6 Yellow · 7 Cyan · 8 Brown. Never renumbered.

hidden.description: Hidden tray (R17): tray and caps show '?' until the tray reaches the front of its lane.

lockTurns.description: Locked tray (R18): opens after this many trays fly to the slots while it stands at the front.
